reason: The reference names the wrong book: this edition prints 'Dtn' (Deuteronomium) where the passage is Daniel 10:9-12, the vision in which the angel's appearance overwhelms the prophet. The sentence it supports is about the angels' splendour bearing witness to their perfection, which Deuteronomy 10:9-12 (the Levites' inheritance and what the Lord requires of Israel) does not touch. A three-letter misprint of a book abbreviation, not a wording question -- all seven other editions cite Daniel here.
